name: x-article-ideas
title_zh: 三圈交集处找选题：读者问、热讨论、你真有料
tagline_zh: 别再拍脑袋想选题。它把评论区真问题、当下热议和你的实战经验叠在一起，自动标出你既懂又有人问的那一格。
tagline_en: Stop guessing topics. It overlaps real reader questions, live debates, and your hands-on experience—then flags.
desc_en: Find article ideas at the intersection of audience questions, current discussion, and the author's actual experience. Use for topic research, angle selection, or developing a thesis from notes and sources.
why_zh: 不是关键词堆砌，而是用集合运算逼你面对「我到底比谁多知道什么」。三圈不交就明说没选题。
why_en: No keyword soup. It runs set logic to force the question 'what do I know that others don't.' If circles don't intersect, it says.
limit_zh: 只处理文本输入：读者问题、讨论链接、个人笔记。不爬取实时数据，不联网验证热度，不生成完整文章——产物是选题。
limit_en: Text in only: reader Qs, discussion links, your notes. No live crawling, no trend verification, no full drafts—output stops at topic, angle, and.
title_en: Article ideas where reader Qs, hot talk & your real.
